mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have partly cloudy skies and 89 degree weather at Fireman Park. Tonight, look for a Waning Gibbous moon and catch the International Space Station crossing the sky from Middleton near Verona High School toward Fitchburg starting at 3:31 AM. Expect an overnight low of 73 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has installed a new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park, which was carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland to celebrate the arts and inclusivity.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Downtown Farmer's Market kicks off at Hometown Junction Park alongside various trivia and live music events happening through the week.

In our weekly police report, on August 30, officers responded to a collision at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street where a vehicle struck a bicyclist, resulting in a citation for failure to yield the right of way.
Stop by today to enjoy the Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day; the store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
